title: Mount Horeb Earthworks

bodyMarkdown:
Above Elkhorn Creek near Lexington, Adena people built a circular ditch-and-embankment enclosure during the Adena period. WPA digs under William S. Webb in 1939 found a ring of large paired posts that likely screened ceremonies before the earthen walls went up. The University of Kentucky now protects a partially reconstructed site as Adena Park.
Source: [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Horeb_Earthworks_Complex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Horeb_Earthworks_Complex)
